The container is a soft roll-up case, not the rigid rectangular box defined in the taxonomy. Only generic checkpoints like 'utilitarian appearance' and 'tools visible' passed. The Fine-Grained Classifier incorrectly predicted 'carpenter's kit' likely due to the visual similarity of 'organized tools in a case', but human verification confirms the semantic mismatch. artifact_reasoning: The image is visually coherent with no catastrophic structural failures. However, there are noticeable micro-artifacts: 1) The metal tools exhibit 'waxy' or smudged reflections rather than sharp metallic specular highlights. 2) The complex mechanical joints of the surgical instruments are simplified and slightly irregular/fused, lacking precise engineering symmetry. 3) Some tool edges blend softly into the dark leather pockets. These are moderate severity issues typical of AI-generated detailed objects, lowering the artifact score from perfect but keeping it above 'broken'.
